observations: Photos show a sewing/weaving machine stand/legs frame with a long rectangular top and two side frames.
There are two rectangular cut-outs/slots on the top surface (likely for mounting the machine or access).
The frame has multiple crossbars and a lower platform with a grid/footrest area.
No sewing machine head/engine is visible—only the base/legs/frame.
The top surface appears to be wood or wood-like panels; the frame is metal (painted black).
One photo shows a ruler/measurement markings along the top edge (text not readable).
No clear brand/model markings are visible on the frame.

claims.evidence: The photos show a machine base/legs frame consistent with a sewing/weaving machine stand (photos 0-3).
The amount is only in the seller’s words; no price is shown in the photos.
Location is only in the seller’s words; no location proof is visible in the photos.

risks.risk: The frame may not match the specific sewing/weaving machine model (mounting hole positions, width, and height).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the mounting points/holes under the top (and the distance between them), plus a photo showing the machine head mounted on it (or a tape measure across the mounting pattern).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic/possibly non-compatible machine base (worst case: buyer may need drilling/adapter).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in these angles (bent legs, loose welds, rust under paint).
risks.proof: Photos of all leg corners and weld joints (front/back/underside) and a short video showing the frame being shaken to check looseness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown structural integrity (worst case: needs repair).

risks.risk: Top surface damage (cracks, warping, or water damage) that affects stability.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the top panel edges and the cut-out areas, showing any cracks or splits.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear (worst case: top may need replacement).

risks.risk: Missing parts: the seller may be selling only legs/frame, not the full machine base accessories (brackets, bolts, motor stand, etc.).
risks.proof: A photo showing everything included laid out (bolts/brackets/any accessories) and a checklist of what is included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as frame/legs only (worst case: buyer must source missing hardware).

proof_requests: Close-up of the mounting holes/cut-outs with measurements (center-to-center distances).
A photo or short video of the machine head mounted on the frame (or a test fit).
Underside/weld-joint photos and a quick shake test video.
List of included items (bolts/brackets/any accessories) with photos of what comes with it.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a sewing/weaving machine legs/base frame, but the key pricing factor is compatibility and structural condition; those cannot be verified from the current angles and missing mounting details.
